subject: french
title: Subcultures and Belonging
welcome_lead: Identities also covers subcultures — groups defined by shared style, language or values. How does belonging shape self?
meta_desc: French: subcultures, group belonging and identity formation.
final_note: Belonging is bilingual — in identity and in language.

concepts.def: Subculture — a cultural group within a wider society.
To identify with — to feel connection to a group.
Diversity — variety of identities and backgrounds.
Stereotype — a fixed simplified image of a group.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use appartenir a: J'appartiens a un groupe de musiciens. To compare: contrairement aux idees recues (contrary to received ideas).
Useful phrases: Il ne faut pas generaliser, chaque personne est unique. The subjunctive after il faut que signals strong opinion.
Open with a statistic or anecdote. Use selon une etude recente to introduce evidence. Conclude with a reflection on what diversity offers society.
